channel.title: The Pabsmophobia Monthly Haunt
channel.description: Field notes, publication archives, and balanced investigation analysis.

item.title: Why the Paranormal World Should Embrace Debunking (Just as Much as Belief)
item.description: Why sitting on the fence and demanding bulletproof evidence isn't the enemy of paranormal research—it's the only honest path to real discovery.

item.title: A Seat at the Table: When Our Loved Ones Visit on Special Days
item.description: There's a unique kind of quiet on special occasions—birthdays, anniversaries, holidays—after the wrapping paper is cleared and the candles are blown out. In the midst of the celebration, many of us feel a faint, unmistakable echo, a sense that someone is missing, and yet, somehow, they are also present.

item.title: Bridging the Unknown: A Balanced Look at the Paranormal Tool Kit
item.description: Explore the fascinating world of ghost hunting equipment and discover the ongoing debate between believers and skeptics regarding how they work.

item.title: Unveiling the Unseen:Your Essential Ghost Hunting Toolkit!
item.description: Hey fellow paranormal enthusiasts! We've all seen the dramatic ghost hunting shows, full of figures creeping through abandoned buildings in the dead of night, clutching mysterious gadgets. But what are all those tools, and how do they supposedly help us connect with the other side?

item.title: 👻 Wired for the Unknown: How Gender Psychology Shapes Our Behaviour on Ghost Hunts 🔦
item.description: Exploring Danny Dyer's 'How to Be a Man' through the lens of paranormal investigations, stress psychology, and the human spectrum.

item.title: Ghost in the Machine: Why the Panasonic DR60 and SLS Cameras Fail as Paranormal Investigation Tools
item.description: High-tech ghost hunting tools like the Panasonic DR60 and SLS camera don't detect spirits—they produce technology-driven false positives.

item.title: The Host’s Dilemma: Balancing Public Expectation with Paranormal Credibility
item.description: How lead hosts for commercial ghost hunts can keep guests engaged while maintaining strict scientific credibility and avoiding tech-driven false positives.

item.title: The Power Stays On: How to Debunk False Positives When You Can't Kill the Mains
item.description: How to separate true paranormal anomalies from routine noise when investigating commercial venues where shutting off the power isn't an option.
